title: Rhode
slugLine: A month of Instagram content for Rhode that promotes Rhode World and new launches and brings Justin Bieber into the brand.

rows.kpi: Comments, shares, saves and reposts; follower growth after each post

design.lead: Rhode posts every day across three content pillars, mostly in carousels, because Instagram is where people window-shop for products.

blocks.title: Content pillars

clauses.label: Product showcase
clauses.text: drives product education and builds the product aesthetic.

clauses.label: Behind the scenes
clauses.text: an inside look at photoshoots and Hailey’s life builds an intimate connection with the brand and the Biebers.

clauses.label: Overall brand vibe
clauses.text: curates the aesthetic and branding that draw people to Rhode.

blocks.note: Series running through the month: Spotwear, Rhode x The Biebers, Rhode World.

blocks.title: Format mix
blocks.note: Carousels show variations and examples of a product, so they carry the product showcase. Reels give quick storytelling with visual and audio hooks, for behind the scenes and brand vibe. Single posts carry quick, consumable visuals and information.

blocks.title: Production needs
items: A product and lifestyle shoot with Justin, Hailey and models
A graphic designer for product-education infographics
Influencer and creator collaborations, and UGC
On-site creators shooting behind the scenes at Rhode World, including visitors joining in the activities
Aesthetic shots of the 818 and Patrón cocktail bar collabs

blocks.title: Calls to action
items: “what do you think of this look?”
